Add employees. Everyone you track needs an employee record in WorkPulse. Let's add one.
First, create your departments. Open People, choose the Departments tab, and click New department.
Now open the Employees tab, and click Add employee.
Enter the full name and the work email. Add a job title and an employee ID, if you use them.
Choose the department, the team and the manager. You can also set the employment type, hire date, time zone and location.
Turn on Invite to WorkPulse. This creates an account, and emails the employee a link to set a password. They use it to sign in to the desktop agent.
Click Add and send invite. The new employee appears in the list.
Click a name to open the profile. There you can edit details, see attendance, and manage devices and permissions.
If someone can't use email, register a device on their profile instead, and give them the enrolment code for the desktop agent.
Done. Next, install the desktop agent on each computer.
